profile.name: CHAN
profile.availability: Available for Remote Roles & High-Impact Projects
profile.bioShort: Frontend developer passionate about building interactive, 3D-infused digital experiences with cinematic precision and clean code.
bioExtended: I am a creative frontend developer based in Cambodia, driven by the intersection of modern web engineering, fluid motion, and real-time 3D graphics.

Over the past 3+ years, I have specialized in turning ambitious concepts into smooth 60fps web applications. My foundation is built upon deep mastery of HTML, modern CSS architectures, JavaScript (ESNext), React.js, and TypeScript, amplified by WebGL and Three.js.

I believe that the web should not just present information—it should captivate and respond intuitively. Whether crafting spatial commerce interfaces or lightning-fast dashboards, I focus relentlessly on responsive precision, accessibility, and micro-interactions.

projects.title: CyberStep | Spatial 3D Commerce
projects.tagline: Interactive 3D product customization engine with WebGL lighting
projects.description: A futuristic spatial e-commerce flagship prototype for custom cyberpunk sneakers. Built with Three.js and React, featuring real-time material shader swaps, dynamic studio lighting tracks, interactive 360° orbital exploration, and responsive checkout flows.
highlights: Procedural studio lighting with adjustable soft shadows and reflection probes
Instant colorway switcher with metallic PBR material shader interpolation
Mouse-driven dynamic focal depth and camera zoom constraints
Mobile-responsive touch drag rotation with inertia damping

projects.title: Aetheria | AI Node Prompt Studio
projects.tagline: Visual node-based canvas for orchestrating multi-step AI reasoning pipelines
projects.description: An advanced generative prompt engineering interface featuring an infinite interactive canvas, draggable LLM workflow nodes, live output stream monitors, and dynamic connection wires with neon pulses.
highlights: Infinite zoom/pan hardware-accelerated canvas using custom matrix math
Curved Bezier wires with directional pulse particles signaling active tokens
Live syntax-highlighted code editor for prompt variables and function definitions
Context-aware node palette with instant keyboard shortcut filtering

projects.title: OmniPulse | Real-Time Crypto Terminal
projects.tagline: High-frequency algorithmic trading dashboard with telemetry sparklines
projects.description: A dark-mode cyberpunk financial workspace designed for active crypto asset tracking. Features sub-second candlestick updates, depth book visualizer, multi-wallet balance monitor, and sound-cued trade notifications.
highlights: Zero-lag order book visualizer with live volume depth heatmaps
Synthesized Web Audio clicks and sound pings on executed limit orders
Configurable multi-pane drag-and-drop dashboard layout with persistent local state

projects.title: Angkor Legacy | Virtual Khmer Museum
projects.tagline: Interactive 3D cultural preservation gallery of ancient Khmer temple artifacts
projects.description: A tribute to Cambodian cultural heritage, bringing 12th-century Angkor Wat stone sculptures and bas-relief carvings into interactive 3D WebGL space. Includes historical audio commentary and bilingual Khmer-English inscriptions.
highlights: Draco-compressed high-detail 3D photogrammetry scans of Bayon temple faces
Spatial 3D audio reverberation matching stone corridor acoustic profiles
Dual typography system gracefully pairing Khmer Unicode with modern Syne sans
Light/Shadow simulation matching real-world Siem Reap solar azimuth positions
